messages:
sara: Quick thread to agree on a DP prioritization + rehab flow we can publish to sales and CS. Exec wants a simple scorecard and a friendly reinstatement path.

kim: TL;DR: Score partners on impact, effort, and signal reliability. If they fall below cut we outreach, offer support, then pause if no recovery. Rehab path should be explicit.

josh: From PM side: require partners to self-identify "primary outcome" (latency, accuracy, UX). We boost tickets tied directly to that outcome in our short-term backlog. Helps prioritize customer-driven asks.

amit: Engineering asks: include a 7-day platform-update grace window and weight regressions by severity. Also include a small FF to opt partners into advanced perf knobs for measurement.

lex: Legal: short one-liner for invites about retention (30d archive) and KMS handling for private installs. Also we should be explicit about export formats and support SLA for data pulls.

ops-bot: automation: onboarding templates and eviction notice stubs at /ops/templates/dp-onboard.md and /ops/templates/dp-eviction.md. Can wire tags and a dashboard tile once owners are assigned.

sara: Draft scorecard (proposal): Impact (1-5), Integration effort (1-5), Availability (1-5), Signal quality (1-5). Invite if sum >=11 and Availability >=3. Add automatic follow-up if score drops 30% quarter-over-quarter.

kim: Rehab flow suggestion: 1) Outreach within 48h of drop, 2) 7-day help window with 2 scheduled support touchpoints, 3) if no improvement: 7-day notice then pause. Reinstatement: 2 consecutive weeks meeting engagement thresholds OR a one-off activation smoke run pass.

josh: Add concrete engagement thresholds in the doc: >=2 active sessions/week OR >=20 API calls/week over rolling 3 weeks. Structured feedback: >=1 eval/sprint. If both miss, trigger outreach.

amit: Implementation detail: metric owners = product-telemetry (sessions), infra (api_calls), evals (structured evals), ci (smoke-run). Ops, can you create a starter dashboard showing these?

ops-bot: yes, will scaffold a tile after owners are tagged. Deployment windows Thu 18:00 UTC. Recommend using tag `dp_cohort_v2` for partner accounts.

lex: I'll prepare the invite blurb and short eviction FAQ. Keep tone collaborative and clear about archiving and KMS steps.

sara: Small code-y snippet for the dashboard rules (for engineers):
```
# pseudocode rule
if (rolling_api_calls_3w < 20 && rolling_sessions_3w < 2) and (structured_evals_last_2sprints == 0):
  trigger_outreach()
  start_7_day_help_window()
```

kim: Love it. For prioritization: when partners submit asks, we attach the partner score + the primary outcome tag. We score requests higher when aligned with the primary outcome and when partner score > 12. This ensures strategic partners get prioritized without manual triage.

josh: I'll prototype a small CSV export of the scorecard and a column for "primary_outcome". That will be useful for sales/CS.

sara: Owners: sara (doc + dashboard mock), josh (scorecard CSV + outreach templates), kim (rehab flow + partner comms), lex (legal blurb + FAQ), ops (dashboard tile + tagging). Target: final draft by Fri COB.

amit: Minor ask: include a short rollback clause so partners know they won't be left in a broken state during platform regressions. Grace window covers it but add explicit line in the invite.

lex: will add that line.

sara: Thanks all. I'll post the draft in /product/dp-priority-rehab-onepager.md and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
